title: Total Knee Replacement
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Assess the temperature and the effusion, since both raise infection in a replaced knee.
Measure the range, recording the extension deficit and the flexion separately.
Assess the alignment standing, since the replacement should have corrected it.
Assess stability in extension and in flexion, because a replaced knee can be stable in one and lax in the other.
Assess the extensor mechanism, including the ability to hold the leg straight and the patellar tracking.
Assess function and the walking distance, since the operation was done for function.
